import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Combine product and size for detailed categorization
df['product_size'] = df['product'] + ' (' + df['size'] + ')'

# Calculate total revenue per product-size combination
revenue_by_product = df.groupby('product_size')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
revenue_by_product.plot(kind='bar', color='teal')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product and Size', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Product and Size', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save output
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Combine product and size for detailed categorization
df['product_size'] = df['product'] + ' (' + df['size'] + ')'

# Calculate total revenue per product-size combination
revenue_by_product = df.groupby('product_size')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
revenue_by_product.plot(kind='bar', color='teal')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product and Size', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Product and Size', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save output
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
